units.source_text: “当学仆的时候，卷烟抽光了，我就抽烟袋锅……”

en.t: When I was working as a student servant, once the cigarettes ran out, I would smoke a pipe...

units.source_text: 名人慢悠悠地抽着烟，一边说道，

en.t: The master smoked leisurely as he said,

units.source_text: “我把积存在袖兜里的烟末都塞上去抽了。

en.t: I even stuffed in and smoked all the tobacco scraps that had collected in my sleeve pocket.
Even so, I felt quite satisfied.
